input_domain: One immutable generated PDF 1.7 with exact expected PDF/IR/request/resource identities, declared physical page count and primitive existing job context
known_issues: The 300-second limit is checked between synchronous calls and before returning; it does not preempt an already-running inspector. Each unchanged adapter retains its own finite worker timeout and guards.
Invocation count is bounded to 24 adapters for 64 pages. This does not count every descendant process or certify an aggregate CPU/RSS/temporary-storage envelope.
Coordinator source contains no PDF parser. Native calls remain guarded by their existing independently pinned execution profiles.
No retries, parallel execution, cached receipts or durable checkpoint/resume is supported. Failure exposes no partial result.
Caller-provided job, request and scientific IR hashes are external expectations, not authenticated by this component.
Existing result flags remain conservative: no full PDF/UA, visible-content or finding completeness, text/source equivalence, cryptographic worker authentication or report release.
The optional coordinator admits at most 64 pages and 16 MiB. Standalone inputs above 64 pages retain the 8-MiB ceiling; the default 32-page/8-MiB rendering route is unchanged.
output_type: Existing PdfInspectionSet: full revalidated unsigned metadata only
